name: Ahmad Zulkifli
bio:
Ahmad's passion for motorsport ignited early, fueled by attending the Malaysian Grand Prix as a child. He started his career in event security, quickly rising through the ranks due to his sharp attention to detail and proactive approach. His unique blend of technical aptitude and innovative thinking allows him to anticipate and mitigate potential security risks effectively. 

He believes in a preventative security strategy, emphasizing thorough planning and the implementation of cutting-edge security technologies. Ahmad is committed to ensuring the safety and integrity of the team's operations, both on and off the track. His pragmatic nature allows him to make decisive decisions under pressure, making him an invaluable asset to any motorsport team.

physical.description: Ahmad is of average height, with a lean build and a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down observations.
Has a habit of meticulously checking and re-checking security protocols.
Prefers to communicate through concise memos and reports.
